textSegments: Complies with ATX12V V2.52 / Flex ATX V1.23
Compliant with UL/EN/IEC international safety standards
Quiet and long-lasting 40mm ball bearing fan
Black cables for the need of enthusiasts
Complete protections: UVP, OVP, SCP, OPP, OTP
Fully modular design with all black ribbon cables simplifies installation,  which allows you to use only the cables you need, for a much neater build.
FlexGuru series featured with high power density, 20% higher than any Flex PSU in the same wattage and frame.

FSP pioneered the development of the Beetle technology in FLEX-ATX PSU, and we applied it on the  FlexGuru series. The new technology strengthens the fixation adequacy by 25% which makes the PSU  fit in most of the Flex-ATX chassis in the market.
Unlike general FLEX PSUs, FlexGuru series is designed with inner 40mm fan, noise cancellation and achieving maximum cooling at all times.
The efficiency of your power supply directly affects your system's performance. FlexGuru 300W has a guaranteed typical efficiency of 90%, offer the high conversion power to boost your system.

FSP Group brings you the latest technologies in  renewable energy, they provide a full range of additional safety features to keep up with the latest regulations. FSP has upgraded the majority of their power supplies to the latest UL# 62368 standard.

OVP (Over Voltage Protection), UVP (Under Voltage Protection), OPP (Over Power Protection), SCP (Short Circuit Protection), and OTP (Over Temperature Protection), a full guardian circuit protections to keep your hardware safe.
Using Japanese electrolytic capacitors, FlexGuru series offers a stable output and long-term reliability you need.
